name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 37 - Am 53
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 37c. Underlines that the Commission needs to take further timely actions to increase the Union’s own resources and to fight tax avoidance; recalls that, according to the EU Tax Observatory, multinational corporations (MNEs) booked USD 1 trillion in profits in tax havens in 2022, half of which were in tax havens in the Union; calls, therefore, on the Commission and the Member States to collect the tax deficit of MNEs, namely the difference between what a corporation pays in taxes globally and what that corporation would have to pay if all its profits were subject to a minimum tax rate of 25 % in each of the countries where it operates;
